name: pickup_reconcile_primary_and_network_copy_spawn_lists
description: Pickup::ReconcilePrimaryAndNetworkCopySpawnLists publishes pkt11 create deltas for primary-only spawns and flag-2 deltas for network-copy-only spawns.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup spawn-list/network packet source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e890 validates walking g_PickupSpawnList_Primary.head, calling Pickup::SpawnListContainsPickupId against g_PickupSpawnList_NetworkCopy, sending Pickup::SendPkt11_CreateDelta for primary spawns missing from the network copy, then walking g_PickupSpawnList_NetworkCopy.head, checking against g_PickupSpawnList_Primary, and sending Pickup::SendPkt11_Flag2Delta for network-copy spawns missing from primary.
The native reconcile smoke verifies a primary-only spawn sends one pkt11 create delta and a network-copy-only spawn sends one pkt11 flag-2 delta through the reliable network send path.
